body.x: Farmkit (CEO Sun Yang) has announced its participation in CES 2025, which will be held from January 7 to 10 in Las Vegas. The company will exhibit at the K-Startup Pavilion, showcasing its AI-powered diet recommendation solution, FoodQ.

Farmkit, a food tech company, has developed AI-based solutions to help users enjoy healthy and delicious diets. With its innovative "Food AI" solution, the company strives to make nutritious eating accessible to everyone. Experts in food and AI technology collaborate to enhance the sophistication of its offerings.
At CES 2025, Farmkit will present FoodQ, which delivers personalized diet recommendations by analyzing users’ health information, food data, and individual preferences.

Built on Farmkit’s proprietary Taste Intelligence technology, FoodQ is a food shopping curation solution. As an AI-as-a-Service (AIaaS) platform, it integrates with existing online food marketplaces and Food O2O app services. Its primary aim is to improve and expand purchasing and gourmet experiences within food commerce environments.

FoodQ collects diverse personal data, such as taste preferences, texture preferences, and dietary restrictions, including religious considerations. It then links this data with individual health metrics to recommend tailored grocery items and ingredients.

This personalized approach enables suppliers to deploy targeted marketing strategies while providing consumers a superior shopping experience. According to Farmkit, the synergy between supply and demand could significantly enhance the food market ecosystem.

Farmkit highlighted that FoodQ currently collaborates with over 40 online food marketplaces, specialized sales channels, and digital healthcare service companies to support consumers in maintaining a "healthy gourmet" lifestyle. The company has received positive feedback from domestic users, accelerating its growth. Starting December 2024, Farmkit is launching its service on the Shopify app, initiating cross-border operations targeting the North American market.

A Farmkit representative stated, “CES 2025 provides an invaluable platform for introducing our FoodQ platform to global players in the advanced technology and food industries, including large enterprises, SMEs, and startups. We aim to uncover new business opportunities and forge partnerships that will support the expansion of our North American operations.” The company also emphasized its commitment to identifying potential partners and clients who can help drive its North American market expansion.
